channel.name: Globe Tape
channel.tagline: Every place on Earth has a story on tape. We hit rewind.

videos.title: Macy's Parade Postponed by Thanksgiving Storm | World News
videos.summary: A Thanksgiving storm postponed the Macy's parade for the first time in its 100-year history and left more than 900,000 US homes and businesses without power.

videos.title: The Turkey Isn't From Türkiye, India or Peru
videos.summary: Why is a turkey called a turkey? It's a North American bird, yet English names it like the country, Turkish (hindi) and French (dinde) name it after India, Dutch after Calicut and Portuguese after Peru. Every farm turkey traces back to Mexico.

videos.title: Iowa Lead Azide Detonation: 4,500 kg Destroyed | World News, Nov 25
videos.summary: The US Army destroyed about 4,500 kilograms of degraded lead azide at an Iowa ammunition plant, and early EPA readings showed no airborne lead.

videos.title: Did the Korean War Ever Really End?
videos.summary: Did the Korean War ever really end? The fighting stopped on 27 July 1953 with an armistice, a military ceasefire, but no peace treaty has ever been signed. And the border it left isn't the 38th parallel: it's where the front line froze.

videos.title: Chile Is Longer Than Lisbon to Moscow
videos.summary: How long is Chile? 4,270 km from north to south, but only 177 km wide on average. Lay it over Europe with its southern tip on Lisbon and it doesn't stop at Moscow: it keeps going for another 360 km, crossing ten countries on the way.
sources: Library of Congress, Chile: A Country Study
outline measured and placed on Natural Earth

videos.title: Nvidia Brings Back Jensen Huang | World News, Nov 23
videos.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO, and its shares closed more than 31% higher on Monday.

videos.title: Why Is Norway Richer Than Sweden?
videos.summary: Why is Norway so rich? In 1970 Sweden was 44% richer per person. Then the North Sea was split down the middle in 1965, Ekofisk was found on Norway's side in 1969, and Norway taxed the oil and saved it abroad: a fund now worth over $2 trillion.
sources: World Bank (GDP per capita, current US$)

videos.title: Kaliningrad: Why Does Russia Own It?
videos.summary: Why does Russia own Kaliningrad, a piece of land squeezed between Poland and Lithuania, inside the EU and NATO and two countries away from the rest of Russia? We rewind to 1945, when it was still the German city of Königsberg.

videos.title: Russia Sold Alaska for 2 Cents an Acre
videos.summary: Why did Russia sell Alaska? In 1867 it was hard to defend, far from St Petersburg and next door to British Canada, so Russia sold it to the United States for $7.2 million: about two cents an acre. Today Alaska pumps $7 million worth of oil every few hours.

videos.title: How Much of Ukraine Does Russia Control?
videos.summary: How much of Ukraine does Russia control? About 19% in November 2026, according to DeepStateMap: roughly 114,000 km², an area bigger than Portugal. We rewind the map to 2013 and watch the front line move, month by month.

videos.title: The True Size of Africa: US, India and EU Fit
videos.summary: What is the true size of Africa? On a Mercator map Greenland looks just as big, but Africa is 14 times larger: the mainland US, India and all 27 EU countries fit inside it at the same time, with almost half the continent to spare.
sources: fit measured on Natural Earth outlines

videos.title: Lesotho: The Country Inside South Africa
videos.summary: Why is Lesotho inside South Africa? It's a whole independent country, about the size of Belgium, completely surrounded by a single neighbour. Even its lowest point sits 1,400 metres above sea level: a world record.
